title: mut.channel_marc_da_costa_matthew_niederhaus
mutation_directive: Lumen Prize winner — Marc Da Costa & Matthew Niederhauser (2024 · Interactive Immersive) — 'Parallels'. VISUAL SIGNATURE: An LED volume where a neural network re-renders the audience's silhouettes as drifting parallel-line fields, perception slipping between figure and pattern. TECHNICAL HOOKS: Particles constrained to parallel rails; viewer presence (camera/mouse) bends the rails into figure-shaped warps that snap back when attention moves — geometry: instanced line segments; palette: monochrome LED amber on black. REF: https://lumenprize.org/winners-archive
